correctness.rationale: The proof derives the unique mean-zero unpunctured potentials from the 2m/3m Laplacian eigenspaces, applies a rank-one Laplacian inverse update with explicit positive denominator, and partitions all surviving edges into four orbits. The embedded stdlib polynomial certificate verifies the corrected potentials algebraically, the fixed sign of each of 80 weighted voltage-difference classes on all integers m>=2, all four exact Q/P column sums, and every maximizer/increase inequality. An independent exact-fraction grounded-Laplacian construction corroborates 535 whole columns for m=2,...,6. Finite checks are not used as an infinite proof. The claim only concerns real Euclidean-orthogonal projections.

value.rationale: The finding supplies an infinite dense graph family where a single edge deletion increases both canonical endpoint projection norms (with sharp m=2 exception for cycle projection), reversing the naive direction inferred from a biclique comparison. It also establishes two distinct threshold changes of the norm-maximizing edge orbit, exact all-parameter rational invariants and a common 1/(3m) perturbation scale. These are meaningful operator/graph structural results rather than arbitrary finite enumeration or an unmotivated special value.
